thread:
Alex Cheng: quick vendor sync notes: we need to finalize SKU tagging semantics for marketplace and the driver/firmware gating matrix for SI certs. targets: H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. keep answers short so Priya can lock embargo.
Priya Gupta: vendor timeline highlight 1: H200 firmware candidate 2025-05-12, may still push a microcode tweak post-freeze. need policy on accepting microcode-only patches.
Johan Larsson: ops concern: B200 sustained thermal derate reported in lab under long-sequence inference. suggestion: ship as "Sustained" vs "Burst" SKU or include per-SKU QoS notes. that affects marketplace capacity tags and reservation pricing.
Mateo Rosas: SI side 1: ONNX + TF integrations require exact driver + cuda/rocm pairs. I'll publish a CI matrix. quick example test we run in lab: ```docker run --rm -v /data/tests:/tests redwood/ci:gpu /tests/run_inference.sh``` please confirm pinned driver versions.
Nvidia Liaison Bot: vendor update posted: H200 firmware freeze scheduled 2025-05-14 UTC; MI300 kernel ABI merge planned 2025-05-20; Gaudi bring-up patch expected 2025-05-18. All tentative.
Alex Cheng: comms ask 1: if any of these dates slip, we must shift embargo/announce windows by >= 2 weeks to avoid fragmented availability. Priya to own embargo handshake.
Amir Patel: noted. I'd like a fallback announce plan: if H200 delayed, we announce H100+MI300 first, with a follow-up H200 wave. need message templates for press and marketplace.
Priya Gupta: I can own embargo but need final SKU list, gating matrix, and partner signoff by EOD Fri. otherwise we miss the corporate comms calendar.
Johan Larsson: action: I'll draft SKU naming proposals for B200 ("b200-sustained" vs "b200-burst") and include perf caveats + pricing delta. target Thu.
Mateo Rosas: action: will publish CI matrix (CSV) with driver versions and test status; will include short repro steps and a small perf table. target Thu EOD.
Nvidia Liaison Bot: vendor policy note: post-freeze microcode patches allowed only for security or safety fixes. functional microcode updates require a minor firmware release and retrigger of cert tests.
Alex Cheng: operational ask: if vendor enforces minor-release requirement, runtime must support routing fallback (route to H100 or MI300 variant) for affected request classes. ops-sre to model cost and latency impact.
Amir Patel: I'll draft contingency wording + embargo slide for execs. will circulate once Priya confirms dates.
Priya Gupta: starting deps doc now. will ping this thread with final gating matrix link.
Alex Cheng: good sync. tiny follow-up: include marketplace image tags for the launch images (e.g., redwood/h100:2025-05, redwood/mi300:2025-05) in the deps doc so marketplace infra can stage images.
Johan Larsson: ack. I'll add image tag proposal and note about thermal derate in SKU description.
Mateo Rosas: uploading CI CSV to product-announce once validated.
Nvidia Liaison Bot: reminder: next vendor bridge scheduled 2025-05-07 16:00 UTC.
Alex Cheng: thanks everyone 1 :white_check_mark:
